explication: LangChain is an agent-engineering framework for composing prompts, models, tools, retrieval, and structured outputs. A typical workflow starts with a developer invoking a runnable or agent, which formats inputs, calls a language model, optionally dispatches tools or retrieves knowledge, and parses the resulting output. Core abstractions support both modern runnable composition and classic chains. Callbacks and tracers provide operational visibility, while loaders, embeddings, vector stores, and record managers support data-augmented applications. Some integration relationships are inferred from documented interfaces because only selected source excerpts were sampled.
